data: Applied Materials Phase 2 organizer sample set: 20 pairs (8 Set A nominal, 6 Set B degraded, 4 Set C absent, 2 Set D optical RGB).
important: This is the ONLY evaluation in this repository on organizer-generated data. It is a measurement of the frozen solver, run after freezing. No threshold, weight or parameter was fitted to it; the refinement-pass change shipped this session was validated on our own p2_val corpus and only confirmed here. The file records aggregate metrics only -- no organizer coordinates or imagery are reproduced.

runtime.note: inside the 5 s median budget with an 8% margin; 4x clear of the 20 s hard cap

false_positives.note: The presence model reports found=1 on these absent pairs while the correctness score column ranks them below every present pair. Choosing a threshold from that observation would be tuning on organizer data, which the addendum lists as a no-appeal disqualification, so it was deliberately not done.
